info.name: FreeGency
info.description:
FreeGency API — organized for frontend screens.

**Setup:** set `baseUrl`, then run **01 → Sign In & Sign Up → Sign In**.

**Sections:** Auth · Platform Lookups · Profiles · Client Projects.

item.name: 03 · Profiles
Client Profile

request.description: Returns client profile with nested `interests` → `specialties` → `skills`.
Update name, country, bio. Add `ProfileImage` as file field if needed.
Creates a client profile for the logged-in user. Returns 409 if one already exists.

item.description: Read and update the logged-in client profile.

item.name: Client Interests

request.description: Appends category IDs without removing existing interests. Requires at least one category.
Replaces all client interests. Pass `"categoryIds": []` to clear all.
Removes all client interests (empty replace).

item.description: Categories the client is interested in (profile-scoped).

item.name: Client Specialties

request.description: Appends specialty IDs. Requires at least one specialty.
Replaces all client specialties. Pass `"specialtyIds": []` to clear all.

item.description: Specialties linked to the client profile.

item.name: Client Skills

request.description: Replaces all client skills. Pass `"skillIds": []` to clear all. No POST/add endpoint.

item.description: Skills linked to the client profile (replace only).

item.name: Developer Profile

request.description: Returns developer profile with nested `interests` → `specialties` → `skills`.
Creates a developer profile for the logged-in user. Returns 409 if one already exists.

item.description: Read and create the logged-in developer profile.

item.name: Developer Interests

request.description: Appends category IDs without removing existing interests. Requires at least one category.
Replaces all developer interests. Pass `"categoryIds": []` to clear all.

item.description: Categories the developer works in (profile-scoped).

item.name: Developer Specialties

request.description: Appends specialty IDs. Requires at least one specialty.
Replaces all developer specialties. Pass `"specialtyIds": []` to clear all.

item.description: Specialties linked to the developer profile.

item.name: Developer Skills

request.description: Replaces all developer skills. Pass `"skillIds": []` to clear all. No POST/add endpoint.

item.description: Skills linked to the developer profile (replace only).

item.name: Switch Profile Mode

request.description: Toggles active profile mode between Client and Developer. Creates the target profile if missing. Returns `"Client"` or `"Developer"`.

item.description: Toggle between client and developer mode.

Client & developer profiles, interests, specialties & skills.

All endpoints require Bearer token (`{{accessToken}}`).

Base path: `api/v1/profiles`
